examples.title: What is this key protected with? (no password)
Prove an encrypted EC key is usable (non-extractable import)

description: Describe a PKCS#8 private key WITHOUT its password: format ('pkcs8' or 'encrypted-pkcs8'), version, kind (ec / rsa / rsa-pss / ed25519 / ed448 / x25519 / x448 / ml-dsa / unknown), curve, algorithm OID and name, attributes, whether a public key is embedded; for an encrypted key the PBES2 parameters (PBKDF2 iterations, PRF, AES key size, salt length, ciphertext size) or the name of a scheme pkinative refuses (PKCS#12 / PKCS#5 v1.5 ciphers). `tryImport:true` additionally imports the key into a NON-EXTRACTABLE Web Crypto key and reports the handle (type, algorithm, usages) — an encrypted key then needs `password` (or PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD; SECRET_REQUIRED) and `keyType` (KEY_TYPE_REQUIRED), an RSA key needs `rsaScheme` (RSA_SCHEME_REQUIRED, no default); a wrong password is PKI_CRYPTO_DECRYPTION_FAILED and a legacy cipher PKI_KEY_ENCRYPTION_UNSUPPORTED with the openssl pkcs8 remedy. No result ever carries a key byte, a scalar or the password: the report is an allow-list view and the key never leaves the engine (nothing exports or writes a key here). A PUBLIC KEY or a non-PKCS#8 DER is refused with the PKI_* cause. A call carrying a password is never cached. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary' (format, kind, curve, encrypted, scheme, imported). Input: pem / derBase64 / path. inspect_pkcs12 is its PKCS#12 counterpart; use it before sign_cms / create_csr to learn what a signer needs (keyType, rsaScheme).

allowSha1.description: Accept or produce SHA-1 signatures (legacy material you already trust). Default false: refused with PKI_CRYPTO_ALGORITHM_REFUSED on read, VALIDATION_ERROR on write.

encodingRules.description: 'der' (strict X.690 DER, default) or 'ber' (indefinite / non-minimal lengths and constructed strings, as legacy CMS producers write).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep after verbosity (arrays map over elements); unmatched paths land in _meta.unmatchedFields.

hash.description: Signature hash of the imported key. Default: the curve's hash for ECDSA (SHA-256/384/512), SHA-256 for RSA; refused for Ed25519 / Ed448. 'SHA-1' needs allowSha1:true. With tryImport:true only.

key.description: The PKCS#8 private key (PRIVATE KEY or ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY PEM, or DER): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path. A SEC1 / PKCS#1 key must be converted first (openssl pkcs8 -topk8).

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

keyType.description: The type of an ENCRYPTED key (it reveals its type only once decrypted). With tryImport:true only; KEY_TYPE_REQUIRED when missing for an encrypted key.

limits.description: Raise pkinative's 22 named security bounds for this call (trusted input only; absent keys keep the engine defaults). A value above an operator ceiling (PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED) is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED; describe_engine lists the defaults and the ceilings.

maxAttributes.description: The attributes of one attribute set. Default 256.

maxBerSegments.description: The segments joined from one BER constructed string. Default 10000.

maxChainLength.description: The certificates one certification path may hold. Default 10.

maxCmsCertificatesAndCrls.description: The certificates and revocation entries one SignedData carries. Default 1024.

maxDepth.description: The nesting depth of constructed values. Default 64.

maxExtensions.description: The extensions of one certificate or request. Default 256.

maxGeneralNames.description: The GeneralName entries of one field. Default 10000.

maxInputBytes.description: The size of one DER input, or the length of one PEM text. Default 67108864.

maxIntegerBytes.description: The content length of one INTEGER converted to a bigint. Default 8192.

maxKdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iteration count honoured in one derivation. Default 10000000.

maxNameAttributes.description: The attributes of one distinguished name. Default 1024.

maxNodes.description: The number of values decoded from one input. Default 200000.

maxOcspSingleResponses.description: The SingleResponse entries of one OCSP response. Default 256.

maxOidBytes.description: The content length of one OBJECT IDENTIFIER. Default 256.

maxPathsExplored.description: The candidate paths explored while building one (the RFC 5280 §6 work bound). Default 1000.

maxPemBlocks.description: The blocks read from one PEM text. Default 10000.

maxPkcs12Bags.description: The SafeBags read from one PKCS#12, across every SafeContents. Default 4096.

maxPkcs12KdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iterations one PKCS#12 costs in total. Default 10000000.

maxPolicies.description: The policies or policy mappings of one extension. Default 1024.

maxPolicyNodes.description: The live nodes of the RFC 5280 valid_policy_tree. Default 4096.

maxRevokedCertificates.description: The entries walked in one CRL revokedCertificates list. Default 1000000.

maxSignerInfos.description: The signers of one SignedData. Default 64.

password.description: The password of an encrypted PKCS#8 key or a PKCS#12 file (UTF-8). Never echoed, logged or cached. Alternatively set PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD in the server environment and omit this input (never both) — the variable keeps the secret out of the model transcript.

pemMode.description: 'strict' (RFC 7468 exactly, default) or 'lax' (tolerates whitespace, line length and RFC 1421 headers).

rsaScheme.description: REQUIRED to import an RSA key: 'pkcs1' (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) or 'pss' (RSA-PSS); pkinative has no default (RSA_SCHEME_REQUIRED). With tryImport:true only.

saltLength.description: RSA-PSS salt length in bytes (rsaScheme:'pss' only; default: the hash length). With tryImport:true only.

strict.description: Escalate the first engine warning to a PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of listing it in diagnostics[].

tryImport.description: Also import the key into a NON-EXTRACTABLE Web Crypto key and describe the handle (never exported). An encrypted key then needs password and keyType; an RSA key needs rsaScheme.

name: inspect_private_key

outputSchema.description: Private key description (allow-list view, never a key byte). Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

algorithmName.description: The name of the key algorithm OID (ecPublicKey, rsaEncryption, Ed25519 …), plain keys only.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal concerns the engine raised (PKI_DIAG_*, de-duplicated, at most 200; explain_code explains one).

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when distinct diagnostics beyond the 200 listed were dropped.

encrypted.description: true for an ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY (format encrypted-pkcs8).

anyOf.description: With tryImport:true: the key was imported (decrypted for an encrypted key) into a non-extractable Web Crypto key, described here and never exported.

encrypted.description: true when the password was used to decrypt the key.

imported.description: The import proof (full), or its ok flag (summary).

scheme.description: The password-based encryption scheme of an encrypted key.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the DER structure (ciphertext included for an encrypted key).

title: Inspect private key (PKCS#8 description, optional import proof, no key byte)
